content.title: CGNX Q3 Deep Dive: AI Product Rollout and End Market Shifts Shape Outlook
content.summary: Machine vision technology company Cognex (NASDAQ:CGNX) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 18% year on year to $276.9 million.
